name: Garganacl
description: Garganacl, the Rock Salt Pokémon, and the evolved form of Naclstack. A Rock type.
pokedex_entries: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.
Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.
